notes.title: Melon Autodrop Update
notes.content:
[b]Game Update[/b]
Melon will now automatically trigger item drops (1 minute check intervals), the game does [b]not[/b] need to be in focus for this check.

More info on our official Discord!
https://discord.gg/2puCUVAMb4
